title: fix(metrics): always set update_name tag on client request metrics

files.patch:
@@ -51,6 +51,8 @@ to docs, or any other relevant information.
   credentials set through `setHeaders` no longer appear in logs.
 - The JavaDoc of `WorkflowClient.startUpdate` and `WorkflowClient.startUpdateWithStart` no longer describes these calls
   as asynchronous.
+- Client request metrics (`temporal_long_request_latency` etc.) now always carry the `update_name` tag (default
+  `none`), fixing Prometheus tag-key conflicts when Workflow Updates are used (#3210).
 
 ## [1.41.1] - 2026-11-16

@@ -64,12 +64,13 @@ public static Map<String, String> defaultTags(String namespace) {
   }
 
   private static Map<String, String> tags(String namespace) {
-    return new ImmutableMap.Builder<String, String>(9)
+    return new ImmutableMap.Builder<String, String>(11)
         .put(NAMESPACE, namespace)
         .put(ACTIVITY_TYPE, DEFAULT_VALUE)
         .put(OPERATION_NAME, DEFAULT_VALUE)
         .put(SIGNAL_NAME, DEFAULT_VALUE)
         .put(QUERY_TYPE, DEFAULT_VALUE)
+        .put(UPDATE_NAME, DEFAULT_VALUE)
         .put(TASK_QUEUE, DEFAULT_VALUE)
         .put(STATUS_CODE, DEFAULT_VALUE)
         .put(EXCEPTION, DEFAULT_VALUE)
